name: Multi Panel (Jose fork)
author: inasis
description:
Show a top bar on every monitor, not just the primary one.

• Clock/calendar, Activities and Quick Settings mirrored on each secondary monitor
• Transfer individual indicators (e.g. clipboard, keyboard layout) to the panel of another monitor
• Optional layout management of the main panel: per-indicator position (left/center/right), order, visibility, padding and panel height — off by default, the stock panel is left untouched
• Per-monitor screenshot support

Configure everything from Settings.

Fork of multi-monitors-add-on (spin83) / multi-panel (inasis), updated for GNOME Shell 50.
